parameters.content:
## Setup
Select Header Auth (X-Api-Key) in Send to KSeF Gateway. Read README: static data requires serialized executions; process crashes require reconciliation with KSeF.

## Webhook secret
Set WOO_WEBHOOK_SECRET or webhookSecret in Configuration (EDIT ME). Environment takes precedence. n8n 2.x blocks $env access by default.
The secret in webhookSecret is visible in Configuration output and workflow exports. Prefer an environment variable (`N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`) or your own credential/verification node; do not share workflow exports. Execution saving (success, error, manual and progress) is disabled — check after import.

## Receive & Verify
Accepts the WooCommerce webhook and checks its HMAC signature before trusting the payload.

## Build & Check
Country: billing.country (default PL). ID: first nonempty order meta value, in buyerIdMetaKeys order. Configure the keys for your NIP/VAT plugin.
PL: normalized NIP, VAT from line taxes. EU: euVatNumber + euB2bVatRate (0 WDT). Outside EU: taxId + country + exportVatRate (0 EX). GR/EL and XI supported; GB is outside EU.
Defaults target goods, unlike Sellf (digital products). For services/digital content change rates to np II (EU) / np I (outside EU). 0 WDT requires EU VAT ID. For zw add exemptionBasis.
Net unit price = total / quantity (also shipping/fees); no VAT added. Foreign B2C/OSS is outside scope. Missing/invalid ID or inconsistent data: skipped with reason, no reservation/POST. No VIES/eligibility lookup.

## Reserve, wake & send
Global state blocks repeat sends. Uncertain results require KSeF reconciliation. See README for durability limits.

## Node setting required
This Code node needs `require('crypto')`. Self-hosted n8n: set `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto` in the n8n environment, then restart.

nodes.name: WooCommerce Webhook
nodes.notes: Raw Body is required so the signature check below sees the exact bytes WooCommerce signed.

nodes.name: Configuration (EDIT ME)
nodes.notes: Fill in your KSeF Gateway URL, seller details, and the WooCommerce webhook secret before activating this workflow.

nodes.name: Verify Signature
nodes.notes: Verifies WooCommerce's base64 HMAC-SHA256 X-WC-Webhook-Signature header and re-parses the raw body for downstream nodes.

nodes.name: Respond Unauthorized
nodes.notes: Dead end: bad or missing signature. Nothing downstream trusts this payload.

nodes.name: Invoice Valid?
nodes.notes: Invalid business identifiers/configuration return a reason before reservation or HTTP.
